tools.name: get_census_tract_for_address
tools.description: Look up the census tract for a US street address with the official US Census Bureau Geocoder. Returns the matched address, latitude and longitude, the 11-digit tract GEOID and tract number, block group and block GEOIDs, state and county FIPS, incorporated place, county subdivision, congressional dis

tools.name: get_census_tract_for_coordinates
tools.description: Census tract, block group, block, county, place and congressional and state legislative districts for a latitude and longitude, from the US Census Bureau Geocoder.

tools.name: explain_census_geoid
tools.description: Split a census GEOID (2 digits state, 5 county, 11 tract, 12 block group, 15 block, or with a 1400000US style prefix) into state and county FIPS, tract code, the tract number as Census displays it (012405 is 124.05), block group and block. No network call.
